description: Eight attenuverters, each with a voltage offset and voltage control over both, and a mix output carrying the average of the rows that are fed

params.text: Scales the signal on that row between -1 and +1, so the counter-clockwise half of the travel inverts it
Shifts that row by a fixed -5V to +5V after the attenuverter has scaled it
Multiplies every output, the eight rows and the mix, by 1 or by 2; the doubling is applied after the ±10V limit, so an output can reach ±20V

inputs.text: The signal for that row, scaled by the attenuverter and then shifted by the offset
Multiplies the attenuverter knob by a tenth of this voltage, so 10V gives the knob's own setting and a patched cable at 0V silences that row
Adds to the offset knob volt for volt, this jack's own reading held between ±10V

outputs.text: That row's input scaled by the attenuverter and then shifted by the offset, held within ±10V and multiplied by the switch; with the row's input jack empty it carries the attenuverter times the offset
The average of the rows whose input jacks are patched, multiplied by the switch

notes: every attenuverter comes up at zero, so a signal patched into a row does not reach its output until that row's knob is turned
